**Article Details for PMID: 30905518**

**Title:** Metformin was associated with lower all-cause mortality in type 2 diabetes with acute coronary syndrome: A Nationwide registry with propensity score-matched analysis.

**Authors:** Chien-Boon Jong, Kuan-Yu Chen, Mu-Yang Hsieh, Fang-Ying Su, Chih-Cheng Wu, Wen-Chol Voon, I-Chang Hsieh, Kou-Gi Shyu, Jun-Ted Chong, Wei-Shiang Lin, Chih-Neng Hsu, Kwo-Chang Ueng, Chao-Lun Lai

**Journal:** International journal of cardiology
**Publication Date:** 2020-05-14
**DOI:** 10.1016/j.ijcard.2019.03.021

**Abstract:**
No randomized controlled trials evaluating metformin therapy efficacy in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM) and acute coronary syndrome (ACS) have been reported. We aimed to examine the mortality benefit of metformin therapy in patients with type 2 DM and ACS, compared with non-metformin anti-diabetes agents users.
